## Scope check

Before submitting, please confirm this feature is consistent with EEO's build posture:

- [ ] This does not introduce a composite score, country ranking, or company certification.
- [ ] This does not expand the platform into global atlas scope (beyond the active pilot corridor).
- [ ] This does not publish claims without a source, method, confidence label, and evidence layer.
- [ ] This does not use AI to make final publication, legal, or disclosure decisions.
- [ ] This does not add a community reporting module before protection protocols are documented.
- [ ] This does not require exposing exact sensitive geospatial coordinates publicly.
